The desktop installer brings everything along, a video waits for ffmpeg instead of failing, and KnightLoader is built with Go 1.27.4. Questions go to the support thread, bugs and ideas to issues.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The desktop installer downloads ffmpeg, Java and JDownloader while it installs,** each with its own progress, so the app has everything at its first start. Without a connection the app fetches them itself, as before, and the last page of the installer says why.

## 🔒 Security

- **A rare race in Go's HTTP server could crash KnightLoader's web server.** KnightLoader is built with Go 1.27.4, which fixes it ([GO-2026-6859](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6859)), in the container, the relay and the desktop app.
- **Reading a brotli-compressed answer, such as JDownloader's status, could take far more memory than it should.** The brotli library is at 1.2.8 ([GO-2026-6888](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6888)).

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A YouTube video sent right after installing the desktop app no longer fails with "No ffmpeg".** The app fetches ffmpeg when it first starts, and a video that needs it now shows "Waiting for ffmpeg" and starts once ffmpeg is in place. Thanks to @sabascos for the report in [#169](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/169).
